# WYN Consultancy

> WYN is a London-based AI consultancy for agencies and marketing teams. It helps them work out where AI fits (Advise), train their people to use it (Train), and builds AI tools, automations and experiences for them (Build). WYN is led by Jules, a Strategy Director with over a decade in agencies including Anomaly, We Are Social and Jungle Creations.

- Audience: creative, social, media and integrated agencies; in-house marketing and brand teams at mid-size and large companies.
- Location: London, UK. Works with teams anywhere, remotely or on site.
- Contact: wyn-consultancy@gmail.com or https://wyn-consultancy.com/contact
- All prices exclude VAT. Every project has a fixed scope and price agreed before it starts.

## Services and pricing

- [Services and pricing](https://wyn-consultancy.com/services): every offer with prices and an FAQ
- [Advise](https://wyn-consultancy.com/services/advise): Opportunity Session £600 (credited against follow-on work); AI Audit & Roadmap from £2,500; tool selection; Fractional AI Lead from £1,800 a month
- [Train](https://wyn-consultancy.com/services/train): team workshops for up to 12 people, half day from £1,500, full day from £2,750; upskilling programmes and talks on enquiry
- [Build](https://wyn-consultancy.com/services/build): AI newsrooms, content analytics engines, AI workflows and automations, internal tools, campaign experiences and websites; automations and tools from £3,500
